functions.name: crear_booking_token
functions.arguments: p_paciente_id uuid, p_medico_id uuid, p_phone_number text DEFAULT NULL::text
functions.return_type: TABLE(token text, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crear_booking_token(p_paciente_id uuid, p_medico_id uuid, p_phone_number text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(token text, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  INSERT INTO booking_tokens (paciente_id, medico_id, phone_number)
  VALUES (p_paciente_id, p_medico_id, p_phone_number)
  RETURNING booking_tokens.token, booking_tokens.expires_at;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_default_estado_programada
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_default_estado_programada()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT id FROM public.estados_consulta WHERE codigo = 'programada' LIMIT 1;
$function$

functions.name: get_medico_id
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_medico_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT id
  FROM public.medicos
  WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    AND deleted_at IS NULL;
$function$

functions.name: get_user_email
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_email(user_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN (SELECT email FROM public.usuarios_pms WHERE id = user_id);
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_user_role
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT r.nombre
  FROM public.usuarios_pms u
  JOIN public.roles r ON u.rol_id = r.id
  WHERE u.id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.usuarios_pms u
    JOIN public.roles r ON u.rol_id = r.id
    WHERE u.id = auth.uid()
    AND r.nombre = 'Administrador'
  );
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin(user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.usuarios_pms u
        JOIN public.roles r ON u.rol_id = r.id
        WHERE u.id = user_id
        AND r.nombre = 'Administrador'
    );
END;
$function$

functions.name: is_staff_member
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staff_member(user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.usuarios_pms u
        JOIN public.roles r ON u.rol_id = r.id
        WHERE u.id = user_id
        AND r.nombre IN ('Recepcionista', 'Medico', 'Administrador')
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_created_by()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
